JOIN order_totals ot2 ON ot2.order_id = ot.order_id AND ot2.period_label = ot.period_label
GROUP BY ot.period_label, ot.payment_type
ORDER BY ot.period_label, ot.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT t.order_id, o.order_status, t.order_total, t.dist_payment_types
FROM (
  SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_total, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_type) AS dist_payment_types
  FROM order_payments p
  JOIN orders o2 ON o2.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE o2.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-01-01' AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-02-01'
  GROUP BY p.order_id
) t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
ORDER BY t.order_total ASC, t.order_id
LIMIT 5;

쿼리 작성: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(t.order_total) AS total_payment
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_total
  FROM orders o

  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
    AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date < o.order_approved_at
  GROUP BY o.order_id

쿼리 작성: SELECT HOUR(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS purchase_hour,

쿼리 작성: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(t.order_total) AS total_payment
FROM (

  FROM orders o

  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-04-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'not_defined' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0

쿼리 작성: SELECT pt.payment_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pt.order_id) AS order_count,
       AVG(ot.order_total) AS avg_order_total
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_total
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL
  GROUP BY o.order_id
) ot
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, p.payment_type
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-05-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-06-01'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL
) pt ON pt.order_id = ot.order_id
GROUP BY pt.payment_type
ORDER BY pt.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT p.order_id, p.payment_type, p.payment_value
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-06-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 1 AND MAX(p.payment_installments) >= 3
) t
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = t.order_id
ORDER BY p.order_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT pt.payment_type,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pt.order_id) AS order_count,
       AVG(ot.max_installments) AS avg_max_installments
FROM (
  SELECT o.order_id, MAX(p.payment_installments) AS max_installments
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-09-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-10-01'
  GROUP BY o.order_id
  HAVING SUM(p.payment_value) >= 150 AND SUM(p.payment_value) < 300
) ot
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, p.payment_type
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-09-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-10-01'
) pt ON pt.order_id = ot.order_id
GROUP BY pt.payment_type
ORDER BY pt.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT o.customer_id,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
       SUM(t.order_total) AS total_payment
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS order_total, COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_type) AS type_cnt
  FROM order_payments p
  GROUP BY p.order_id
) t ON t.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-07-01'
  AND t.type_cnt >= 2
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY total_payment DESC, o.customer_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT x.payment_type,
       x.payment_value AS max_transaction_value,
       x.order_id,
       o.order_purchase_timestamp
FROM (
  SELECT p.payment_type, p.order_id, p.payment_value
  FROM order_payments p
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-11-01'
) x
JOIN (
  SELECT p.payment_type, MAX(p.payment_value) AS max_value
  FROM order_payments p
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-10-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-11-01'
  GROUP BY p.payment_type
) m ON m.payment_type = x.payment_type AND m.max_value = x.payment_value
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = x.order_id
ORDER BY x.payment_type, x.order_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT pt.payment_type,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       AVG(CASE WHEN o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS approved_ratio
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT order_id, payment_type
  FROM order_payments
) pt ON pt.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'canceled'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY pt.payment_type
ORDER BY pt.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  o.order_id,
  SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END) AS credit_card_amount,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(p.payment_value) > 0
    THEN ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_type = 'credit_card' THEN p.payment_value ELSE 0 END) / SUM(p.payment_value), 2)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS credit_card_ratio_percent,
  MAX(p.payment_installments) AS max_installments
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-11-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-12-01'
GROUP BY o.order_id
ORDER BY o.order_id;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  p.payment_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_estimated_delivery_date >= '2018-03-01'
  AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date < '2018-04-01'
  AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NULL
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY p.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  o.order_id,
  p.payment_type,
  SUM(p.payment_value) AS payment_amount
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-04-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-05-01'
  AND o.order_id IN (
    SELECT op.order_id
    FROM order_payments op
    GROUP BY op.order_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3
  )
GROUP BY o.order_id, p.payment_type
ORDER BY o.order_id, p.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  t.order_id,
  DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS days_to_delivery,
  t.total_payment,
  t.payment_type_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.order_id,
    SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_type) AS payment_type_count
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-12-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY o.order_id
  ORDER BY total_payment DESC
  LIMIT 5
) t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
ORDER BY t.total_payment DESC;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  DATE_FORMAT(o.order_purchase_timestamp, '%Y-%m') AS ym,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count,
  SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT op.order_id
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN op.payment_type NOT IN ('boleto','debit_card') THEN op.payment_type END) = 0
) ok ON ok.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY ym
ORDER BY ym;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  q.num_qualified AS qualified_orders,
  t.total_orders,
  ROUND(100.0 * q.num_qualified / NULLIF(t.total_orders, 0), 2) AS qualified_ratio_percent,
  s.sum_payment AS qualified_total_payment
FROM
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_qualified
    FROM (
      SELECT o.order_id
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
      WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-10'
        AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-20'
        AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
        AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_approved_at) < 3
      GROUP BY o.order_id
      HAVING SUM(p.payment_value) >= 150
    ) x
  ) q
CROSS JOIN
  (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS total_orders
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-10'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-20'
  ) t
CROSS JOIN
  (
    SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) AS sum_payment
    FROM order_payments p
    WHERE p.order_id IN (
      SELECT o.order_id
      FROM orders o
      JOIN order_payments p2 ON p2.order_id = o.order_id
      WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-04-10'
        AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-04-20'
        AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
        AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_approved_at) < 3
      GROUP BY o.order_id
      HAVING SUM(p2.payment_value) >= 150
    )
  ) s;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  opt.payment_type,
  AVG(ot.total_payment_records) AS avg_payment_records_per_order,
  COUNT(DISTINCT opt.order_id) AS order_count
FROM (
  SELECT p.order_id, COUNT(*) AS total_payment_records
  FROM order_payments p
  GROUP BY p.order_id
) ot
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.order_id, p.payment_type
  FROM order_payments p
) opt ON opt.order_id = ot.order_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = opt.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-09-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-10-01'
  AND o.order_status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
GROUP BY opt.payment_type
ORDER BY opt.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  p.payment_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.order_id) AS order_count
FROM order_payments p
WHERE p.order_id IN (
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_payments op ON op.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-10-01'
    AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
    AND DATEDIFF(o.order_delivered_customer_date, o.order_purchase_timestamp) <= 10
  GROUP BY o.order_id
  HAVING SUM(op.payment_value) >= 250
)
GROUP BY p.payment_type
ORDER BY p.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  t.payment_type,
  AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_approved_at)) AS avg_approval_hours,
  AVG(s.total_payment) AS avg_order_total_payment,
  COUNT(DISTINCT t.order_id) AS order_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.order_id, p.payment_type
  FROM order_payments p
) t
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = t.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT p.order_id, SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_payment
  FROM order_payments p
  GROUP BY p.order_id
) s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2018-11-01'
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-12-01'
  AND o.order_approved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.payment_type
ORDER BY t.payment_type;

쿼리 작성: SELECT
  o.order_id,
  p.payment_type,
  SUM(p.payment_value) AS payment_amount,
  s.total_payment,
  ROUND(100 * SUM(p.payment_value) / s.total_payment, 2) AS payment_share_percent,
  TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_approved_at) AS approval_hours
FROM orders o
JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT op.order_id, SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
) s ON s.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE DATE(o.order_purchase_timestamp) = '2017-01-15'
GROUP BY o.order_id, p.payment_type, s.total_payment, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_approved_at
ORDER BY o.order_id, p.payment_type;
